channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A wildfire on the New York-Massachusetts border is seventy percent contained. Firefighters used controlled burns to stop the fire from spreading across two hundred fifty acres. No homes are at risk, but officials ask people to stay clear of firefighting zones.

Workers at Healthy Living grocery stores in Vermont and New York are fighting to unionize. The company disputes the vote and has appealed, delaying contract talks. Organizers say owners are intimidating workers and firing union leaders to block the union.

Vermont's oldest craft brewery, the Vermont Pub & Brewery, is closing after nearly four decades. They say business has not recovered since twenty-twenty, with foot traffic down twenty percent this summer. The closure highlights ongoing concerns about crime and homelessness in downtown Burlington VT.

A Rutland mother is fighting to raise awareness for pediatric cancer after losing her young daughter. Danielle Jankowski is raising funds and educating the community about the need for more research. Local police and fire departments are backing her efforts to support families affected by this disease.
